name: Meneghetti Wine Hotel & Winery
positioning: Wine hotel and winery on an Istrian estate of vineyards and olive groves, with a stone farmhouse at its core, a spa built on estate olive oil and grape extracts, pool villas and a beach club on the Adriatic
best_for: Wine and olive oil lovers who want tastings in the Wine Lounge at the heart of the winery
Couples or small families who want a villa or residence with its own garden, pool or vineyard view
Active travelers who want a private tennis court, a golf driving range and days at the beach club

facts.text: The Meneghetti estate has 40,000 grape vines, 13 wine labels, 700 olive trees and 4 olive varieties.
The Wine Lounge is set at the heart of the winery, surrounded by olive groves and vineyards, for tasting the estate's wines and olive oils.
The Tranquillity Pool is a heated indoor pool reserved for quiet relaxation.
The Garden Spa has an outdoor Finnish sauna and cold plunge set within landscaped gardens.
The Spa Lounge is a relaxation lounge with heated waterbeds and herbal infusions.
The estate has a private tennis court framed by countryside and vineyards.
The estate has a golf driving range.
Guests can do a sensory tasting of four estate olive oils.
A private truffle hunt in Istria's forests is followed by a tasting.
The Vineyard Garden Residence has a private garden and a vineyard view.
A few accommodations are in the original farmhouse, or stancija, and the newer buildings are built in the same style as the original house.
The lobby mixes carefully curated antiques with pops of modern art.

highlights.text: Spa rituals use cold-pressed olive oil from the estate, grape extracts from its vineyards and herbs such as lavender, sage and immortelle.
The Estate Pool Villas each have a private garden and pool.
The Meneghetti Beach Club is on the Adriatic.
The outdoor pool sits at the edge of the vineyard next to two large oaks.
A sunset sail on the Adriatic offers the chance to watch dolphins with Rovinj's old town in view.

considerations.text: The spa's indoor heated Family Pool welcomes families during dedicated hours.
The Wine Lounge tasting room is open to anyone, not just hotel guests.
WhataHotel notes the remote countryside location requires a car for exploring nearby attractions.

sources.title: Conde Nast Traveler: Meneghetti Wine Hotel & Winery, Istria
